answer: Resist sybils with stake-backed action budgets: each identity draws influence from a token bucket refilled only in proportion to its locked stake, like a reef that lets a zephyr of traffic through but blocks a flood. Splitting one stake across ten thousand identities splits the refill too, so the delta between honest throughput and forged throughput stays zero — total actions per attacker are capped by capital, not by name count. An attacker wanting ten times the influence must lock ten times the stake, while an honest agent spends its single bucket cheaply.
